meta.title: Quick fix "add missing properties" fails with enums from other module
meta.fix_ref: microsoft/TypeScript#60191 (fix(60186): Quick fix "add missing properties" fails with enums from other module), e99e6e2e87, 2024-10-14; git tag --contains: first in v5.7-rc / v5.7.2
meta.build_notes: npm typescript@5.6.3 (2024-10-08) and typescript@5.7.2 (2024-11-22), both behind typescript-language-server@4.3.3 (the latest wrapper release before 5.7.2), started with the pinned tsserver.js; the reported TypeScript version is checked on every session.
meta.notes: The generated initializer '"<module path>".A' is a property access on a string literal: it parses, but does not type-check, hence edit_leaves_diagnostic.

settings_note: The issue names no settings; no tsconfig.json, so tsserver uses an inferred project for the open file and its import.

files.note: split at the fourslash // @filename markers; the marker lines are not part of the files
split at the // @filename markers; the trailing comment line of the block is kept (a comment)

repro.steps: Open index.ts: 'const t:T = {}' is reported (TS2741, property e is missing). Apply the quick fix 'Add missing properties' on t. Reported: the fix writes 'e: "file:///E".A' (the module path as a string literal) instead of 'e: E.A'. Probe: after the fix, a fresh session on the edited file must neither report the targeted TS2741 nor a new error.
